name: Los Be Be Stones
description: Los Be Be Stones is a People Nation street gang founded in 1983 in Melrose Park, Illinois, by siblings Big Juan and Nena, whose family nickname 'Bebes' gave the gang its name. Starting at 23rd and Division Street, the gang spread across multiple Chicago suburbs including Villa Park, Addison, and Glendale Heights. Allied with the Latin Kings as 'Los Be Be Kings' from 1989, they became an official Black P Stones branch in 1995 and adopted their current name.
